title: "Heaven or Hell – Why Ignoring Jesus Is the Most Dangerous Choice" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Heaven or Hell – Why Ignoring Jesus Is the Most Dangerous Choice" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 This message is urgent.
👉 What if today was your last chance to face the truth?

✅ Heaven is real.
✅ Hell is real.
✅ Eternity is not a gamble.
Ignoring Jesus is not just risky—it’s eternally dangerous.
📖 “For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.” (Romans 6:23)
Today, I need to share the truth many avoid, but Jesus Himself warned about it. This is not just a message—it's a wake-up call for your soul.

🌟 What Happens When You Die?
There are only two destinations for eternity: Heaven or Hell.
1. Heaven – Eternal Life with God

A place of perfect peace, joy, and the presence of God.
Reserved for those who have placed their faith alone in Jesus Christ.
📖 “Whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.” (John 3:16)
2. Hell – Eternal Separation from God

A place of torment, regret, and complete separation from God's presence.
Created as judgment for Satan and his demons but also for those who reject the truth.
📖 “They will be punished with everlasting destruction and shut out from the presence of the Lord.” (2 Thessalonians 1:9)
💡 Your destination is determined by one thing: What you do with Jesus Christ.

🔥 The Reality of Sin – Why We Need Jesus
✅ Every person is a sinner.
📖 “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)

✅ Sin separates us from God.
📖 “The wages of sin is death.” (Romans 6:23)

Sin is not just bad behavior—it’s rebellion against God.
The consequence is eternal separation from Him in hell.

🌟 The Good News: Jesus Paid Your Debt!
💡 This is where God’s grace shines the brightest.

God didn’t leave us in our sin.
He sent Jesus Christ—fully God, fully man—to pay the price for us.
On the cross, Jesus took your place.
📖 “But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” (Romans 5:8)
✅ Three Days Later – Jesus Defeated Death!

He rose from the dead, proving His power over sin and hell. (1 Corinthians 15:3-4)
Now, eternal life is a free gift offered to all who believe.
❌ The Most Dangerous Lie: "I’m a Good Person, I’ll Be Fine"
Many believe they are good enough for heaven.
But goodness can never erase sin.
📖 “For by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God— not by works, so that no one can boast.” (Ephesians 2:8-9)
✅ Salvation is not:

Attending church.
Doing good deeds.
Being religious.
Following traditions.
✅ Salvation is:

Trusting in Jesus Christ ALONE for the forgiveness of your sins. (John 14:6)
🌍 How to Be Saved Today (The Gospel)
The Bible makes it simple and clear:

✅ 1. Admit You’re a Sinner
📖 “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)

✅ 2. Believe Jesus Died for Your Sins and Rose Again
📖 “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ and you will be saved.” (Acts 16:31)

✅ 3. Trust in Christ Alone for Salvation
📖 “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.” (Romans 10:13)

👉 That’s it. No works. No rituals. No conditions.
Faith alone in Jesus Christ alone.

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 10, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose Jesus Christ as my Savior. I trust in His finished work on the cross for my salvation, not my works, not my efforts. He alone is my Redeemer and my hope for eternity."

🔥 THE “HEAVEN OR HELL” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Pray and trust Jesus Christ alone today.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends who need to hear the truth today.

🌌 DON’T WAIT – YOUR ETERNITY MATTERS 🌌
📖 “It is appointed for men to die once, and after that comes judgment.” (Hebrews 9:27)

Heaven and Hell are real places.
👉 Only Jesus can save you.

Don’t wait for “one day” to make things right with God—
Today is the day of salvation. (2 Corinthians 6:2)

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 10, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
I come before You today, acknowledging I am a sinner in need of Your grace. Thank You for sending Jesus Christ to die for my sins. I place my faith fully in Him, believing in His death and resurrection for my salvation. Thank You for the free gift of eternal life. Help me to live for You, not out of obligation, but out of love for what You’ve done.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
